description: Source code for handling FCB (Flash Circular Buffer) element information, including CRC calculation, endmarker handling, and validation functions.

methods.name: fcb_elem_crc8
methods.description: Calculates CRC8 over a flash sector element.

methods.name: fcb_elem_endmarker_fixed
methods.description: Sets fixed endmarker for a flash sector element if fixed endmarkers are enabled.

methods.name: fcb_elem_endmarker

methods.name: fcb_elem_info
methods.description: Verifies and retrieves information about a flash sector element, including endmarker validation.
